hypothesis.statement: The three surviving ours-only lwzx/lfs/stfs sites (@ef8, @fd4 twins and the char_stats float pair at @9f4) all want the OPPOSITE of the lever this run proved: the target keeps the base register and puts the whole constant in the INDEX (add r4,r31,r3 + lwz 3368(r4); addi r0,r3,3112 + lfsx f1,r21,r0), while ours materializes a pointer and uses a displacement. Probe I showed that naming the OFFSET as an s32 local does not produce it (MWCC folds the named offset straight into a pointer add, emitting lfs 0(r3)). The untried form is to deny MWCC a reusable pointer temp at those sites: spell the two accesses of the float pair through two textually DIFFERENT index expressions (the two-kinds rule of claim.law.PC_two-load-shape-and-range-check-collapse-are-one-lever, applied to force an index rather than to split a load), so no single pointer value is shared between the load and the store.
